name: Reman Buddhacharya
tagline: I break systems before users do, preventing system failures and critical bugs through manual testing, automation, and API validation.
about: Currently, I am working as a Full-time Software Quality Assurance at Center of Research and Development (CoRD), validating production systems and blocking unstable releases. Focused on reliability, performance, and correctness.
I have tested healthcare, billing, and donation platforms including NCRS, collaborating closely with developers to expose defects early and validate critical business logic.
aboutHighlight: For me, Quality Assurance is not just about finding bugs, it is about reducing risk, protecting users, and building confidence.
